Method of Attack: Unauthenticated remote command execution to take control of devices
Exploitation by state-sponsored hackers (APT5) to gain illegitimate access by bypassing authentication controls
Attack Vector: Vulnerability in SAML SP or SAML IdP configuration on affected Citrix ADC and Gateway devices
Indicators of Compromise: Commands in ns.conf file: add authentication samlAction
Commands in ns.conf file: add authentication samlIdPProfile
